slot.brief: Two lines in symmetric form; decide whether they intersect, are parallel or skew by comparing direction ratios and checking coplanarity.

verdicts.working: Direction vectors are (1,1,-1) and (1,-1,2), so the lines are not parallel. Equating coordinates gives t=2 and s=1 from x,y, but the z-coordinates are 0 and 1, so they do not intersect. Thus they are skew.

working:
